## What's Changed
* Add developer mode toggle and Developer settings tab by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/621
* Upgrade Vite+ from 0.3.1 to 1.0.0 by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/623
* Add attachment browser for finding and trashing unused attachments by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/624
* Query complete collection sets and rename board lanes across all pages by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/627
* Rename, merge, and delete tags across all notes by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/631
* Show note images on Kanban and All Notes cards by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/633
* Migrate UI primitives from Radix to Base UI by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/634
* Add global Quick Search window for notes, tags, and collections (#635)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/635
* Trim startup bundle, thumbnail memory, and idle work by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/636
* Fix stale image src and size after switching notes in rich mode by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/637
* Document that pull requests are not accepted by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/638
* Add opt-in diagnostic logging with local log export by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/639
* Edit collection cells and lane renames in place without rewriting frontmatter by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/640
* Match folder collections by byte-exact prefix instead of LIKE by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/641
* Keep board card and lane order when a lane rename partly fails (#642)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/642
* Add a Tasks tab that lists open checklist items across the space (#643)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/643
* Support ==text== highlights in Rich mode by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/644
* Split the note info sidebar into Stats, Contents, and Backlinks sub-tabs (#645) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/645
* Group slash commands into hover submenus by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/646
* Hide the tab strip when a pane has only one tab (#647)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/647
* Replace the app icon with a Liquid Glass folder design (#648)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/648


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.9.1...v0.9.2
